<section class="main-solution" id="help">

<!--div class="col-lg-6 text-center text-lg-left mb-4 mb-md-0">

      </div-->
<div class="col-lg-12">
<!--What is Neokyo service? -->
<h1 class="main-solution-solveHeader font-gothamRounded mb-3 text-center">Neokyo is a Japan proxy. Here how it works :</h1>
<p class="main-solution-solveText my-3">Neokyo is your full access pass to all those great items you want to buy from Japan. 
                    We pledge to make buying from Japanese sellers not only possible, but also a breeze. That means contacting sellers and professionals on your behalf for no additional cost,
                     checking that your items match seller original description, packing your parcel so it reaches you safe and sound, and so on.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section><div class="container my-5">

	function updateSearchBar(tag){
		var data = document.sb_providers;
				
		if(data[tag] == undefined){
			//do nothing
			return false;
		}
		$('#bn-search-bar').css('background-color', data[tag]['color']);
				
		$('#bn-search-bar-label').html(data[tag]['name']);
		$('#bn-search-bar-label').css('background-color', data[tag]['color']);
		$('#bn-search-bar-label').css('color', data[tag]['font_color']);
		$('#bn-search-bar-label').css('borderColor', data[tag]['font_color']);
				
		$('#bn-search-bar-input').css('borderColor', data[tag]['font_color']);
				
		$('#bn-search-bar-submit').css('background-color', data[tag]['color']);
		$('#bn-search-bar-submit').css('color', data[tag]['font_color']);
		$('#bn-search-bar-submit').css('borderColor', data[tag]['font_color']);
				
		$('#bn-search-bar-provider-input').val(tag);
	}
				
	$('.provider-search-button').click(function(e){
			updateSearchBar($(e.target).data('tag'));	
	});
				
	//updateSearchBar(document.provider_tag);
			
	window.addSearchLoader = function( ){
		setButtonLoading($('#bn-search-bar-submit'));
	}
			
			
	var searchth = new Bloodhound({
		//datumTokenizer: Bloodhound.tokenizers.obj.whitespace('name'),
		datumTokenizer: Bloodhound.tokenizers.whitespace,
		queryTokenizer: Bloodhound.tokenizers.whitespace,
		//prefetch: '../data/films/post_1960.json',
		remote: {
			//url: '../data/films/queries/%QUERY.json',
			url: document.bn_th_route, //buy nippon typeahead route
			wildcard: '%QUERY'
		}
	});
	
	//$('#bn-search-bar-input').typeahead({
	//$('#bn-main-search-typeahead').typeahead({
	$('.search-typeahead-text-input').typeahead({
		highlight: true,
		hint:true,
		minLength:3,
		}, {
		name: 'bn-search',
		display: 'value',
		source: searchth,
		highlight: true,
		hint:true,
		minLength:3,
		templates: {
    		header: '<div class=\"ta-header\"><div class=\"inner\">Translated search suggestions</div></div>',
			suggestion: function (data) {
		        return '<p>' + data.suggestion + '</p>';
		    }
  		}
	});
	$('#bn-search-bar-input').typeahead('val',document.phrase_js);
	
	
	/*
	 * WE set the typeahead values when the typeahead is changed or selected.
	 * Note that here we have set the spid. So this is what the search will run off of.
	 * I believe that the keyword assoicated with the spid id validated against the submitted keyword,
	 */
	document.typeahead_selected = undefined;
	
	$('.search-typeahead-text-input').bind('typeahead:select', function(ev, suggestion) {		
		$('.bn-search-bar-spid-input').val(suggestion.id);
		document.typeahead_selected = suggestion.value;
	});
			
	$('.search-typeahead-text-input').bind('typeahead:change', function(ev, suggestion) {	
		if(document.typeahead_selected != suggestion){			
			$('.bn-search-bar-spid-input').val(undefined);
			document.typeahead_selected = undefined;
		}
	});
			
//# sourceMappingURL=setup.js.map

$('#search-form').submit(function() {
    $('#FilterModal').modal('hide');
    $('#loadingModal').modal('show');
});




$('a[data-toggle="tab"].search-mobile-nav').on('shown.bs.tab', function (e) {
  e.target // newly activated tab
  //e.relatedTarget // previous active tab
  var elm = $(e.target);
  $('.bn-search-bar-provider-input').val(elm.data('provider_tag'));
  
  $('.bn-mobile-search-provider-toggle a[data-toggle="tab"]').removeAttr('style');
  
  
  elm.attr('style','background-color:'+document.sb_provider_settings[elm.data('provider_tag')]['color']);
  //alert( elm.attr('style','background-color:'+document.sb_provider_settings[elm.data('provider_tag')]));
  $('#bn-mobile-search-button').attr('style','background-color:'+document.sb_provider_settings[elm.data('provider_tag')]['color']);
  //  $('#bn-mobile-search-button').attr('style','background-color:#636a6b');
  })

	$('.bn-search-bar-provider-input').val(val);
	
	$('#bn-mobile-search-button').attr('style','background-color:'+document.sb_provider_settings[val]['color']);
  $('#search-form').attr('style','border: 3px solid'+document.sb_provider_settings[val]['color']);
	
}
